capabilities.name: Open banking account and payment access
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent read your bank accounts and start payments through regulated open banking APIs?

US.note: The CFPB Section 1033 rule exists, but a court stayed its compliance dates in October 2025 and the CFPB is rewriting it, so access runs on voluntary bank APIs and aggregators like Plaid, not a mandated regime.

evidence.title: Personal financial data rights
Section 1033
Plaid

GB.note: The CMA9 open banking mandate gives licensed apps account data and payment initiation, and the UK Payments Initiative launched its commercial Variable Recurring Payments scheme in June 2026, starting with a first wave of lower-risk sectors only.

evidence.title: Commercial VRP & UKPI
Open banking takes next step forward with launch of UK Payments Initiative scheme
UK Payments Initiative: UK banks and fintechs launch new payment scheme

DE.note: EU PSD2, applied in Germany through the ZAG and licensed by BaFin, makes banks give account information and payment initiation providers API access, though there is no standard for recurring variable payments yet.

evidence.title: Revised rules for payment services in the EU (PSD2 summary)
Payment Services Directive 2 (PSD2): Directive 2015/2366/EU
Buhl erhält BaFin-Erlaubnis für Kontoinformationsdienste und Zahlungsauslösedienste

BR.note: Open Finance Brasil, run by the Banco Central, is mandatory for large institutions and lets licensed payment initiators (ITPs) start Pix, Pix Automatico and no-redirect (JSR) payments, and IN BCB 746 removes the fixed R$500 cap on JSR payments from 1 October 2026.

evidence.title: Open Finance
Instrução Normativa BCB nº 746, de 16 de junho de 2026
evidence.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil (Diário Oficial da União, copy hosted by Poder360)

evidence.title: Belvo rolls out Pix Automático

MX.note: Article 76 of the 2018 Fintech Law mandates open APIs, but only open-data (and credit bureau) rules exist; the CNBV and Banxico have still not issued the transactional-data rules, so there is no regulated access to your accounts, and aggregators like Belvo work outside a mandated regime.

evidence.title: Ley para Regular las Instituciones de Tecnología Financiera (Article 76)
evidence.publisher: Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores

evidence.title: Se desinfla el open finance en México: de una ley pionera a una realidad operativa
Open Finance Tracker: México
Actualidad en la normatividad fintech en México

CL.note: Ley Fintec 21.521 created the CMF Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas (NCG 514, technical standards in NCG 569 of June 2026), but the CMF pushed its start from July 2026 to July 2027, so it is not live yet.

evidence.title: CMF modifica la normativa que regula el Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas e incorpora anexo técnico
CMF modifica la NCG N°514 e incorpora estándares técnicos para la implementación del Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas
CMF pone en consulta modificación a la NCG N°514 del Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas

CO.note: A voluntary open finance scheme (Decree 1297 of 2022, Superfinanciera Circular 004 of 2024) is in place, and Decree 368 of April 2026 makes it mandatory, but the SFC has not yet set the mandatory rules and timeline.

evidence.title: SFC trabaja en hitos requeridos para implementar modelo de finanzas abiertas obligatorias
Decreto 368 de 2026
La SFC expide regulación sobre las finanzas abiertas en Colombia

IN.note: The RBI Account Aggregator framework lets apps read your accounts with consent (over 500 million consents by September 2026), and third-party UPI apps can start payments for you.

evidence.title: Sahamati ecosystem map
Account Aggregator crosses 500 million consents as India marks 5th AA Foundation Day
UPI product overview

capabilities.name: Bank AI assistant moves money
capabilities.question: Can a bank's own AI assistant send money or pay bills for you by chat or voice?

US.note: Bank of America's Erica can send and request money with Zelle and schedule bill payments inside the mobile app.

evidence.title: Erica, your virtual financial assistant

GB.note: Zopa's AI assistant, Ask, sends money, requests payments and pays invoices from a photo, by voice or chat, for its Biscuit current account customers (launched September 2026). Starling Assistant (March 2026) sets up savings transfers and organises bill payments for personal customers who opt in. Revolut's AIR freezes cards and buys eSIMs, and NatWest Cora handles questions and fraud claims. Lloyds said its agentic assistant would carry out payment requests, but in October 2026 we found no sign it had reached all customers, and we found no Monzo assistant that moves money.

evidence.title: Zopa unveils UK's most helpful banking AI
Zopa AI
Starling launches agentic AI assistant
Lloyds Banking to launch AI-powered financial assistant
UK's Lloyds puts testing at the heart of AI rollout
Revolut enters new era of money intelligence with launch of AI assistant
Being a trusted partner for tomorrow's banking through technology

DE.note: Commerzbank's Ava can block cards, check balances and order products, but we found no sign it makes transfers, Sparkasse chat channels say they do not accept transfer orders, and bunq describes its Finn assistant (December 2025 upgrade) as support and information only. In October 2026 N26's press room listed no AI assistant, ING's virtual assistant in its app only answers questions, and searches found nothing for Deutsche Bank beyond an old Siri transfer feature. Searches for DKB's AI support assistant showed only customer service, with no sign of transfers. We kept the flag because no bank page rules out a launch we missed.

evidence.title: Commerzbank launches AI-based Banking Avatar
bunq launches smarter, more powerful upgrade to GenAI financial assistant

Press

BR.note: Nubank's AI sends Pix from a text, photo or voice message in the app and on WhatsApp (WhatsApp capped at R$800 per transfer), and Itaú (ia.i) and Bradesco also offer AI Pix by chat or voice.

evidence.title: Pix com inteligência artificial agora no app e WhatsApp do Nu
Itaú Unibanco lança ia.i, nova experiência conversacional
Como falar com a BIA e como ela pode te ajudar

MX.note: BBVA México's Blue assistant makes transfers, pays credit cards and sets up cardless withdrawals from a typed or spoken command, with a password check before each one.

evidence.title: Blue es el asistente virtual de la app BBVA
Cuatro funcionalidades de Blue para facilitar la vida de los clientes

CL.note: Itaú Chile launched voice and text transfers to third parties in its app in June 2026, where an AI agent fills in the transfer and the user confirms with Itaú Pass. News reports do not say whether all customers have it, and we found no Itaú page that confirms the rollout. In October 2026 we found no similar feature at BancoEstado, Banco de Chile, BCI or Santander Chile.

evidence.title: Itaú Chile lanza Transferencias por Voz y da un paso hacia la banca conversacional

CO.note: Davivienda's DaviPlata wallet let users who signed up with a QR code move money by voice or AI chat in a first phase from June 2024, but we could not confirm it is open to all users today. The payments app Tpaga (not a bank) launched a WhatsApp AI agent in July 2026 that pays bills and sends Bre-B transfers. Bancolombia's Tabot only answers questions, and we found no assistant that moves money at Nequi.

evidence.title: En DaviPlata ahora podrá manejar su dinero con la voz
Tpaga lanzó el primer agente de inteligencia artificial en Colombia para pagar por PSE
Tabot asistente virtual

IN.note: Indian Bank's AI-TARA voice assistant (unveiled September 2026) does fund transfers and IMPS in 10 languages, according to news reports, but the bank's own investor deck only calls it a voice AI relationship manager and does not say all customers have it. NPCI's Hello! UPI voice payments roll out in phases, and Axis Bank's new branch kiosk (September 2026) has an AI assistant that fills in forms for services like utility bill payments. SBI's YONO Ji assistant answers questions for YONO Business users, and we found no assistant that moves money at HDFC or ICICI.
